saw_lines: Men rarely browse for shirts. They replace one after a wrinkle or stain shows at work, then reorder the same cut.
So the sale happens when the ad names that wrinkle or stain in its first line, before the buyer scrolls past.
Your site shows 4333 reviews, yet 0 of 29 ads carry a proof number. Put the 4333 count on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 21 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 4333 reviews, yet 0 of 29 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers have nothing to trust. Put the 4333 count on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote about pill free clothes.
8 of 29 copy ads open on one antiarrugas line, and the rest use a line once, so no story gets tested. Test two angles against it, one on stain and odor free clothes, one on a traveler’s busy week.
Your site promotes free shipping, yet 0 of 29 ads mention it, so new buyers get no reason to act. Open new ads by answering shipping: free shipping over 100€, delivered in 3 to 5 business days.
2 ads have run 60+ days, yet none of the 28 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Build the next three ads as variations of the oldest winner, and add the 4333 review count to each one.
